norms.text: The family waits in the doorway until the charge is paid.
Coins are laid out and handed across with both hands.

values.text: The Rose's own say over its own dead.

contempts.text: Outsiders who think the Rose answers to Blackrose city.

people.text: The tag-keeper is fair with the book; the carrier is rude with his eyes.

trade.text: The charge pays for the carrying out of the Rose and for the years the family kept the dead.

addressTerms.text: Visitor, to strangers; by name to kin.

neverSaid.text: That the Rose is a prison.

grievances.text: The Chainbreakers write the family into a book as if the family were the debt.

views.text: They need us as much as we need their coin.
